subject: general
question: Which of the following is a UNESCO World Heritage Site?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gangaikonda Cholapuram Temple**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Gangaikonda Cholapuram Temple**, also known as the **Brihadisvara Temple** at **Gangaikondacholapuram**, is a recognized **UNESCO World Heritage Site**. It is part of the **Great Living Chola Temples** group, which showcases the architectural brilliance of the **Chola Empire**. ***Hence, statement 4 is correct.***
 
• **Kamakhya Temple** is a significant **Shakti Peeth** located on the **Nilachal Hill** in **Guwahati**, **Assam**. Although it is a site of immense religious and historical importance, it has not been inscribed on the **UNESCO World Heritage** list. ***Hence, statement 1 is incorrect.***
 
• **Meenakshi Amman Temple** is an iconic **Dravidian** style temple situated in the ancient city of **Madurai**, **Tamil Nadu**. While it is currently on the **UNESCO Tentative List**, it does not yet hold the official status of a World Heritage Site. Hence, statement 2 is incorrect.</
